title: Forehand Shooting Fundamentals #2
description: A forehand shooting station where players collect a puck near the top of the circle, carry it around a pad while keeping it in shooting position, and release once clear of the obstacle.
coaching_points: Keep the puck back in the stance as long as possible.
Use the inside edges while carrying the puck around the pad.
Transfer weight through the shot instead of leaning back.
Finish with weight on the foot closest to the goal.

title: Forehand Shooting Fundamentals #1
description: A basic forehand shooting station that positions the puck behind the player's feet so the shot begins from a stronger loaded position instead of being pushed from in front of the body.
coaching_points: Pull the puck slightly toward the body before shooting.
Keep the head over the puck.
Transfer weight forward through the shot.
Shoot low and hard without leaning away from the net.

title: 5 Cone 2 Shot Station Drill
description: A five-cone puck-control station that finishes with two shots: one after navigating the cone pattern and a second catch-and-release shot from a coach pass after stopping at the net.
coaching_points: Use tight control turns while protecting the puck from the cones.
Keep the blade closed enough to maintain control.
Shoot quickly after clearing the last cone.
Stop at the net, present a target, and release the second shot quickly.

title: Quarter Ice Angle 1 vs 1
description: A quarter-ice 1-on-1 station where the puck carrier slaloms through cones and attacks the net while the defender times a route around a cone to angle the attacker toward the boards.
coaching_points: Defender keeps the stick on the ice.
Use stick position and angle to discourage a cut to the middle.
Match the attacker's speed before closing.
Offensive player keeps the feet moving and protects the puck if forced wide.

title: Three Sided Box Retrieval Station
description: A retrieval station where a player collects two separate pucks from inside a three-sided box, transitions backward out of pressure, pivots forward, and finishes each retrieval with a shot.
coaching_points: Approach each retrieval under control.
Transition backward immediately after collecting the puck.
Pivot forward outside the box without losing puck control.
Accelerate into the shot after each transition.

title: Stick Check Take Away Drill (Studio Rink)
description: A stick-check drill that teaches players to steal the puck from behind by taking a good angle, using leverage underneath the opponent's stick, and immediately counterattacking for a shot.
coaching_points: Approach from a controlled angle with the stick down.
Use a strong bottom hand when the stick gets underneath the opponent's stick.
Use a quick upward tap to free the puck.
Protect the puck with the body immediately after the takeaway.

title: Horseshoe Re-Group One Goalie - #1 (D to D to Center)
description: A full-ice one-goalie flow drill combining a backcheck race, shot and rebound hunt, then a neutral-zone regroup through two defensemen before the second forward attacks the zone.
coaching_points: F1 must protect the puck from the backchecker without losing pace.
Defensemen present good passing angles and move the puck quickly.
F2 times the neutral-zone swing to receive the regroup pass in stride.
F1 returns to the slot to hunt the rebound on F2's shot.

title: Continuous Pass & Shoot Station
description: A continuous station where each player shoots, stops at the net, retrieves a loose puck, and passes to the next skater moving up ice for another shot.
coaching_points: Stop at the net after every shot.
Accelerate with the first three strides toward the loose puck.
Lead the next skater with a pass they can receive in motion.
Maintain focus because the drill runs continuously.

title: D to D to F3
description: An offensive-zone puck-movement drill where the puck goes from the half wall to the strong-side defenseman, across D-to-D, then into F3 in the high slot for a shot through traffic.
coaching_points: Defensemen move the puck quickly across the blue line.
The receiving defenseman works outside the dots to create interior space.
F3 times the route into the high slot instead of arriving early.
After shooting, F3 goes to the net to screen the next repetition.

title: Gretzky 3 on 3
description: A cross-ice 3-on-3 game where each team has a designated Gretzky behind the opponent's goal line. Teams must use their Gretzky after gaining possession before they can attack the net.
coaching_points: Use the Gretzky as a support option to create give-and-go opportunities.
On possession changes, regroup through the Gretzky before attacking.
Players may go below the goal line to support or pressure the Gretzky.
Keep shifts short and fast to maintain decision-making speed.
